name: Corlen Siltwake
source_profile: ● Corlen Siltwake (CN) is the captain of the Lake Wardens and a fierce and accomplished raider who believes Thalessa's restrictions are unnecessarily cautious. Corlen advocates attacking armed escorts and fortified river ports, arguing that the Cadorians will never respect Namaris waters until they learn to fear them.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 71 (source excerpt; may be partial)
